up: Retrieve all compounds that are reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4421722. For each compound, return the compound's ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (pref_name), and its canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles from compound_structures). Also return the document's title and year (from the docs table). The compounds are linked to the document through the compound_records table (compound_records.doc_id references docs.doc_id and compound_records.molregno references molecule_dictionary.molregno). Do not apply any additional filters or restrictions.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, d.title, d.year
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4421722';
